text: make an event pack with a poster a story pic and a reel
withheld: The event is called Lantern Night Market.
The event runs from 6 to 10 PM.
Include the event name, date, time, venue and free entry on all three items.
Make one poster that is four units wide for every five units tall.
Make one story image and one reel, each nine units wide for every sixteen units tall.
All three items should look like they belong together.
Keep the reel text easy to read.
Music and animation are up to you.
No logo or extra event details are needed.
